subject.title: fix: stop selected channel sessions from WebChat

question: Should a Control UI `/stop` for a selected non-global channel session intentionally discard that session’s queued followup and lane work when no browser-local run ID exists?
rationale: The implementation makes this irreversible-for-that-queue user-visible choice through a new protocol option; tests can establish mechanics but cannot choose the intended cancellation policy.

options.title: Approve queue-clearing stop semantics
options.body: Treat selected-session `/stop` as an explicit stop-and-clear action, contingent on exact-current-head proof and preserved compatibility for callers that omit `clearQueued`.

options.title: Stop only active work
options.body: Keep queued followup and lane work intact, limiting the fallback path to active-run cancellation and avoiding silent loss of queued work.

options.title: Expose separate user intent
options.body: Keep ordinary `/stop` active-run scoped and introduce a clearly named UI action only if maintainers want users to opt into clearing queued work.

recommendation.title: Approve queue-clearing stop semantics
recommendation.body: Treat selected-session `/stop` as an explicit stop-and-clear action, contingent on exact-current-head proof and preserved compatibility for callers that omit `clearQueued`.

likelyOwner.reason: The contributor can clarify the intended behavior and evidence, while a repository owner must make the final product decision.
